sentences.en: Good morning, and welcome to the museum - one with a remarkable range of exhibits, which I'm sure you'll enjoy.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到博物馆——这里展品种类繁多、令人叹为观止，相信各位一定会喜欢。

sentences.en: My name's Greg, and I'll tell you about the various collections as we go round.
sentences.zh: 我叫格雷格，接下来参观过程中，我将为大家介绍各个藏品系列。

sentences.en: But before we go, let me just give you a taste of what we have here.
sentences.zh: 但在出发之前，让我先简要介绍一下本馆的展品。

sentences.en: Well, for one thing, we have a fine collection of twentieth and twenty-first century paintings, many by very well-known artists.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们收藏了一批二十世纪和二十一世纪的优秀绘画作品，其中许多出自非常著名的艺术家之手。

sentences.en: I'm sure you'll recognise several of the paintings.
sentences.zh: 我相信大家会认出其中几幅画作。

sentences.en: This is the gallery that attracts the largest number of visitors, so it's best to go in early in the day, before the crowds arrive.
sentences.zh: 这是游客数量最多的展厅，因此最好在一天早些时候入场，赶在人流高峰到来之前。

sentences.en: Then there are the nineteenth-century paintings.
sentences.zh: 接着是十九世纪的绘画作品。

sentences.en: The museum was opened in the middle of that century, and several of the artists each donated one work - to get the museum started, as it were.
sentences.zh: 本馆于该世纪中期建成开放，当时几位艺术家各自捐赠了一件作品——可以说，正是这些捐赠开启了本馆的收藏历程。

sentences.en: So they're of special interest to us - we feel closer to them than to other works.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些作品对我们而言尤为特别——我们对它们的感情，比对其他作品更为亲近。

sentences.en: Audioscripts The sculpture gallery has a number of fine exhibits, but I'm afraid it's currently closed for refurbishment.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：雕塑展厅陈列着若干精品，但很抱歉，目前该展厅正闭馆翻修。

sentences.en: You'll need to come back next year to see it properly, but a number of the sculptures have been moved to other parts of the museum.
sentences.zh: 您需要等到明年才能完整参观该展厅；不过，部分雕塑已被移至博物馆其他区域展出。

sentences.en: 'Around the world' is a temporary exhibition - you've probably seen something about it on TV or in the newspapers.
sentences.zh: 《环游世界》是一个临时展览，您可能已在电视或报纸上看到过相关报道。

sentences.en: It's created a great deal of interest, because it presents objects from every continent and many countries, and provides information about their social context why they were made, who for, and SO on.
sentences.zh: 该展览引发了极大关注，因为它展出了来自各大洲及众多国家的文物，并提供了有关其社会背景的信息——例如制作缘由、使用对象等。

sentences.en: Then there's the collection of coins.
sentences.zh: 此外还有钱币收藏。

sentences.en: This is what you might call a focused, specialist collection, because all the coins come from this country, and were produced between two thousand and a thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 这可谓一个主题明确、专业性强的收藏系列，因为所有钱币均产自本国，且铸造时间介于两千至一千年前。

sentences.en: And many of them were discovered by ordinary people digging their gardens, and donated to the museum!
sentences.zh: 其中许多钱币是由普通民众在自家花园挖掘时发现，并捐赠给博物馆的！

sentences.en: All our porcelain and glass was left to the museum by its founder, when he died in 1878.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的瓷器与玻璃器皿，均为本馆创始人于1878年去世时遗赠给博物馆的。

sentences.en: And in the terms of his will, we're not allowed to add anything to that collection: he believed it was perfect in itself, and we don't see any reason to disagree!
sentences.zh: 根据他的遗嘱，我们不得向该收藏系列增添任何新藏品：他坚信这一系列本身已臻完美，而我们也完全认同这一观点！

sentences.en: OK, that was something about the collections, and now here's some more practical information, in case you need it.
sentences.zh: 好的，以上是对各收藏系列的简要介绍；接下来提供一些实用信息，以备各位需要。

sentences.en: Most of the museum facilities are downstairs, in the basement, so you go down the stairs here.
sentences.zh: 博物馆大部分设施位于楼下地下室，因此请从这里下楼。

sentences.en: When you reach the bottom of the stairs, you'll find yourself in a sitting area, with comfortable chairs and sofas where you can have a rest before continuing your exploration of the museum.
sentences.zh: 到达楼梯底部后，您将进入一个休息区，那里摆放着舒适的椅子和沙发，您可在此稍作休憩，再继续参观博物馆。

sentences.en: We have a very good restaurant, which serves excellent food all day, in a relaxing atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 我们设有一家非常出色的餐厅，全天供应美味佳肴，环境轻松宜人。

sentences.en: To reach it, when you get to the bottom of the stairs, go straight ahead to the far side of the sitting area, then turn right into the corridor.
sentences.zh: 前往餐厅的方法是：到达楼梯底部后，径直穿过休息区，抵达远端，然后右转进入走廊。

sentences.en: You'll see the door of the restaurant facing you.
sentences.zh: 餐厅大门将正对着您。

sentences.en: If you just want a snack, or if you'd like to eat somewhere with facilities for children, we also have a café.
sentences.zh: 若您仅需简单小食，或希望带孩子在配备儿童设施的场所用餐，我们还设有一家咖啡馆。

sentences.en: When you reach the bottom of the stairs, you'll need to go straight ahead, turn right into the corridor, and the café is immediately on the right.
sentences.zh: 到达楼梯底部后，请径直前行，右转进入走廊，咖啡馆即在右侧入口处。

sentences.en: And talking about children, there are baby-changing facilities downstairs: cross the sitting area, continue straight ahead along the corridor on the left, and you and your baby will find the facilities on the left-hand side.
sentences.zh: 说到儿童，地下室设有婴儿护理设施：请穿过休息区，沿左侧走廊继续直行，您和宝宝所需的设施就在左手边。

sentences.en: The cloakroom, where you should leave coats, umbrellas and any large bags, is on the left hand side of the sitting area.
sentences.zh: 寄存处位于休息区左侧，您应在此寄存外套、雨伞及任何大型背包。

sentences.en: It's through the last door before you come to the corridor.
sentences.zh: 它位于您即将进入走廊前的最后一扇门内。

sentences.en: There are toilets on every floor, but in the basement they're the first rooms on the left when you get down there.
sentences.zh: 每层楼均设有卫生间，而在地下室，卫生间则位于楼梯下方后左手边的第一间房。

sentences.en: OK, now if you've got anything to leave in the cloakroom, please do that now, and then we'll start our tour.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在如果您有物品需寄存在寄存处，请立即办理；随后我们将正式开始参观。
